# Tropical Spa

> Luxury Spa & Massage Centre located in Yelahanka, Bengaluru. Certified male and female therapists, private suites, 100% money-back satisfaction guarantee, and exclusive ₹1,000 gift vouchers on qualifying therapies.

## Main Routes
- [Home Sanctuary](https://tropicalspa.in/): Official homepage featuring spa introduction, therapy highlights, ₹1,000 voucher offer, and guest amenities.
- [Yelahanka Centre](https://tropicalspa.in/locations/yelahanka/): Detailed location guide for the wellness centre on Doddaballapura Main Rd, next to Nice Mart in ACSS Complex, Yelahanka, Bengaluru.
- [Pricing & Tariff](https://tropicalspa.in/pricing/): Transparent tariffs for single massage therapies (60/90/120 min), VIP couples packages, and steam add-ons.
- [Classic Swedish Massage](https://tropicalspa.in/services/swedish-massage/): Quintessential European full-body relaxation therapy using warm herbal essential oils to relieve stress and boost blood circulation.
- [Traditional Thai Massage](https://tropicalspa.in/services/traditional-thai-massage/): Ancient dry bodywork combining passive yoga stretching, joint mobilization, and Sen energy line acupressure.
- [Deep Tissue Massage](https://tropicalspa.in/services/deep-tissue-massage/): Clinical myofascial bodywork with firm cross-fiber pressure targeting chronic pain, stiff neck, and deep muscle knots.
- [Couples Massage Retreat](https://tropicalspa.in/services/couples-massage/): VIP double suite experience featuring side-by-side synchronized massages, private steam, and hydrotherapy jacuzzi bath.
